projects.title: AI-Powered Plant Disease Prediction & Intelligent Crop Advisory System
projects.shortDescription: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Python, FastAPI, React Native, MobileNetV2, Computer Vision, Plant Disease Detection, Agriculture
projects.fullDescription:
## AI-Powered Plant Disease Prediction & Intelligent Crop Advisory System

Developed as part of Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2026, this project aims to help farmers identify plant diseases quickly using Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning.

The system allows farmers to capture or upload an image of a plant leaf. A trained MobileNetV2-based deep learning model analyzes the image to identify potential plant diseases and provides relevant disease information along with treatment and prevention recommendations.

### Key Features

- **AI-Based Disease Detection:** Analyzes plant leaf images using a trained deep learning model.
- **Image-Based Prediction:** Farmers can upload or capture leaf photographs for disease identification.
- **Disease Classification:** Identifies potential diseases based on the trained model.
- **Crop Advisory:** Provides relevant treatment and disease prevention recommendations.
- **Farmer-Friendly Interface:** Designed to make the technology accessible through a mobile application.

### Technology Stack

- **Frontend:** React Native
- **Backend:** Python, FastAPI
- **AI/ML:** Deep Learning, CNN, MobileNetV2
- **Core Technology:** Computer Vision and Image Classification

### How It Works

1. Farmer captures or uploads a plant leaf image.
2. The image is sent to the backend for processing.
3. The trained MobileNetV2 model analyzes the image.
4. The system generates a disease prediction.
5. Relevant treatment and preventive recommendations are presented to the farmer.

### Project Objective

To leverage Artificial Intelligence and modern mobile technologies to support farmers in early plant disease identification, improve agricultural awareness, and promote smarter crop management.

projects.title: Ruled Based chatbot
projects.shortDescription: An interactive rule-based chatbot that provides automated responses using predefined rules and keyword matching.
projects.fullDescription:
A Rule-Based Chatbot is a web-based application designed to simulate conversations and provide automated responses based on predefined rules and conditions.

The chatbot processes user messages, identifies relevant keywords or patterns, and generates appropriate responses from a predefined set of rules. It provides a simple and interactive way for users to communicate with the system.

**Key Features:**
- Interactive chat interface
- Automated responses using predefined rules
- Keyword-based message processing
- Real-time conversation experience
- Simple and user-friendly design

**Technologies Used:** PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and Tailwind CSS.

**Project Goal:** To demonstrate chatbot development using rule-based logic and web technologies.
